```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
      E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
      E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: '8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install jq and unzip
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq unzip

      - name: Start ngrok
        run: |
          curl -s https://bin.equinox.io/c/4VmDzA7iaHb/ngrok-stable-linux-amd64.zip -o ngrok.zip
          unzip ngrok.zip
          chmod +x ngrok
          ./ngrok http 3000 --authtoken ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }} --log=stdout --log-format=json &
          echo "NGROK_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 5
          NGROK_URL=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}" https://api.ngrok.com/tunnels | jq -r '.tunnels[0].public_url')
          echo "NGROK_URL=$NGROK_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          NGROK_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_URL }}
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Teardown ngrok
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ env.NGROK_PID }}" ]; then
            kill ${{ env.NGROK_PID }} || true
          fi
```
